name: Sally Kirimiya
source:
Affiliation: Kisaragi Magic Academy 2nd year, Group AFavorite food: Cotton Candy
Gifts:
-Update (can fix broken things, or in other words, repair destructed things)
-Logical Dash (can see the future for a while by thinking logically)
-Iron Maiden (hardens her mind so that she cannot be broken psychologically)

Sally is a true but hardworking genius. She's the only one in the world with 3 Gifts which breaks common sense. In her route, she investigates how to develop a fourth Gift.

[From [url=http://visualnovelspam.blogspot.fi/2013/12/hhg-megami-no-shuuen-thoughts.html]Visual Novel Spam[/url]]
